title: Understanding Model A
text: Model A includes parameters for height in both inches and centimeters, and weight in both pounds and kilograms. Consider how these different units might affect the confidence intervals for each parameter.

title: Understanding Model B
text: Model B only includes height in centimeters and weight in kilograms. Think about how this might simplify the model compared to Model A.

title: Impact of Units on Confidence Intervals

title: Bootstrap Method
text: The bootstrap method involves resampling the data with replacement to create many simulated samples. This helps estimate the variability of the parameter estimates.
